from cfg.loader import load_config

# Test int
cfg = load_config({'port': 80, 'host': 'x'}, {'APP_PORT': '8080'})
assert cfg == {'port': 8080, 'host': 'x'}, f'Got {cfg}'

# Test float
cfg = load_config({'rate': 1.5}, {'APP_RATE': '2.5'})
assert cfg == {'rate': 2.5}, f'Got {cfg}'

# Test bool
cfg = load_config({'debug': False}, {'APP_DEBUG': 'True'})
assert cfg == {'debug': True}, f'Got {cfg}'

# Test str
cfg = load_config({'name': 'foo'}, {'APP_NAME': 'bar'})
assert cfg == {'name': 'bar'}, f'Got {cfg}'

# Test non-APP_ keys are ignored
cfg = load_config({'x': 1}, {'OTHER': '2'})
assert cfg == {'x': 1}, f'Got {cfg}'

# Test keys not in defaults are ignored
cfg = load_config({'x': 1}, {'APP_Y': '2'})
assert cfg == {'x': 1}, f'Got {cfg}'

print('All tests passed')
"

Now it iterates over `env` keys, checks for `APP_` prefix, strips it, lowercases the remainder, and if that key exists in `defaults`, ...
